accent-ink-dark.canonical: light-dark(..., color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-logo-primary) 60%, white)) via --accent-ink

headline.purpose: Section page title (all sections except Dictate).

question.purpose: Duck bubble heading, model card name, drop pond heading.

tab.purpose: Section tabs and menu dropdown triggers.

label.purpose: Answer chips, page subtitle, alert text; key caps at 600.

description.purpose: Row description under the title at 65% ink, clamped to two lines.

shadows.name: glass-shadow
shadows.purpose: Bubbles, cards, model cards on macOS; none elsewhere.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-sheen), 0 12px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.8)

motion.name: ease-paddle
motion.purpose: Spring-like ease for what travels (chip press/lift, 260ms).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Short ease-out for what appears (bubbles 420ms, page 240ms, colour 200ms).

motion.name: duck-say
motion.value: 420ms var(--ease-out); from opacity 0.25, translateY(8px) scale(0.985); stagger 60/120/180ms

motion.name: meter
motion.purpose: Quack meter bars follow mic level.

components.name: Duck Bubble
components.description: A settings group: duck avatar beside a glass speech bubble; heading is the question, rows are answers.
components.html:
How do you want to call me?

Shortcut

Hold to talk, release to paste.

⌥ Space

Push to talk

Record only while the keys are held.
components.css: .ds-say{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--color-text,#ece7dd)} .ds-avatar{display:grid;place-items:center;width:28px;height:28px;flex:none;margin-top:6px;border-radius:999px;color:color-mix(in oklab,#ff6600 60%,white);background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14),0 0 0 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1)} .ds-bubble{flex:1;min-width:0;background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07);border-radius:6px 18px 18px 18px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14),0 0 0 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1),0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04),0 6px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22)} .ds-q{padding:12px 14px 4px} .ds-q h2{margin:0;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px} .ds-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 14px;border-top:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08)} .ds-row:first-of-type{border-top:0} .ds-row h3{margin:0;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:20px} .ds-row p{margin:0;font-size:11.5px;line-height:16px;opacity:.65} .ds-key{min-width:26px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:7px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:22px;background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14),0 0 0 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1),0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)} .ds-switch{width:32px;height:19px;border-radius:999px;background:#ff6600;position:relative} .ds-switch::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:2px;top:2px;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff}

components.name: Answer Chips
components.description: A short fixed choice as capsules; the chosen one in accent fill.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-chip{height:26px;padding:0 11px;border:0;border-radius:999px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--color-text,#ece7dd);background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14),0 0 0 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)} .ds-chip:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)} .ds-chip:active{transform:scale(0.96)} .ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,color-mix(in oklab,#ff6600 60%,white) 75%,transparent);outline-offset:2px} .ds-chip.is-chosen{color:#fff;background:#ff6600;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3)}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Capsule in accent fill for the one main action.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;padding:5px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:0.5px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);color:var(--color-text,#ece7dd);background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14),0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,border-color .15s} .ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:rgb(255 102 0 / 0.3);border-color:#ff6600} .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,color-mix(in oklab,#ff6600 60%,white) 75%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: Glisse segmented control centred in the title bar; the lens glides on a spring.
components.css: .ds-tabs{position:relative;display:inline-flex;padding:2px;border-radius:999px;background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14),0 0 0 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-tabs button{position:relative;width:78px;height:30px;border:0;background:none;font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--color-text,#ece7dd);cursor:pointer} .ds-lens{position:absolute;left:2px;top:2px;width:78px;height:30px;border-radius:999px;background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2);transition:transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)} .ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,color-mix(in oklab,#ff6600 60%,white) 75%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.css: .ds-hero{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:12px 4px 4px;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--color-text,#ece7dd)} .ds-hduck{color:color-mix(in oklab,#ff6600 60%,white);flex:none} .ds-htext{flex:1;min-width:0} .ds-htext h1{margin:0;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px} .ds-htext p{margin:0;font-size:12px;line-height:20px;opacity:.7} .ds-htext kbd{display:inline-block;margin-inline:.3em;padding:0 7px;border-radius:7px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:22px;background:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14),0 0 0 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1)} .ds-meter{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;height:26px} .ds-meter i{width:3px;border-radius:2px;background:color-mix(in oklab,#ff6600 60%,white);opacity:.55;transition:height 120ms ease-out,opacity 200ms ease-out} .ds-hero:hover .ds-meter i{opacity:1}

narrative.overview:
The main window is macOS system glass (`NSGlassEffectView` on macOS 26, vibrancy before it) with a 52px title bar holding the traffic lights and a centred Glisse segmented control. Every settings group is a question the duck asks: a 28px duck avatar beside a translucent speech bubble, the bubble's heading is the question and its rows are the answers. Density is a native macOS settings pane: 13px rows, 11.5px descriptions under the label, controls on the trailing edge.

Depth comes from the window's own glass, not from painted backgrounds: on macOS the page is transparent and every surface is a translucent layer lit by a white top rim. Off macOS the same tokens fall back to flat, opaque surfaces on the palette background. Personality lives in the duck, its speech bubbles and the quack meter; everything else stays plain system UI.
keyCharacteristics: System glass ground; surfaces are translucent panes with a 0.5px rim and a 1px inset top sheen.
One accent, Quacky orange, fixed; text and icons in the accent go through accent ink.
SF system type throughout, small and precise (11.5 to 17px).
Short fixed choices are answer chips, not menus.
Motion is a spring for what travels and a short ease-out for what appears.

rules.name: The Ink-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Accent as text or icon always uses accent ink; fills, rings and borders keep `#ff6600` exactly. Raw `--color-logo-primary` on text is a defect.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Orange marks selection, chosen answers, switches and the meter. Status colours (red, yellow, green at 10% washes) appear only in alerts.

rules.name: The Description-Under Rule
rules.body: A row explains itself in an 11.5px line under its title, never behind an info icon.

rules.name: The Pane-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: Emphasis on a glass pane is an inset accent rim (1.5px active, 1px featured), never a thick border.

dos: **Do** put every new settings group in a `SettingsGroup` bubble phrased as the duck's question.
**Do** render short fixed enums (theme, sound, ducking speed, overlay) as answer chips; device lists and other open or long lists use the menu dropdown.
**Do** route accent text and icons through `--accent-ink` (`text-accent-ink` or `.text-logo-primary`).
**Do** build surfaces from `--glass-*` tokens so the non-macOS fallback stays flat and correct.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: bubble, page and hero animations switch off.
donts: **Don't** paint an opaque background on the macOS window; the page is transparent over system glass.
**Don't** reintroduce a sidebar of tiled grey rows or an info-icon tooltip for row descriptions.
**Don't** add a second accent or let users recolour it; the accent is fixed `#ff6600`.
**Don't** use thick borders for emphasis on glass panes; use the inset accent rim.
